title: Hazel and the Landfall
author: Hazel Pemberton
blurb: Sebastian Yarrow, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
